question: The interventions that contribute to success after a cardiac arrest that occurred in the street are called "survival chain". Which of the following options make up the proper order of its links?

options.opa: Immediate defibrillation. Ask for help. Life support maneuvers. Post-resuscitation care
options.opb: Open the airway. Ask for help. Defibrillation Post-resuscitation care.
options.opc: Immediate thoracic compressions. Defibrillation and request for help. Post-resuscitation care.
options.opd: Word of mouth ventilation Intermittent chest compressions. Defibrillation Ask for help. Post-resuscitation care.
options.ope: Early recognition and ask for help. Early cardiopulmonary resuscitation. Early defibrillation. Post-resuscitation care
